snippet.title: Lightyear Frontier - 1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Lightyear Frontier concludes its Early Access journey with its biggest update yet!

Take to the skies in the Skyblazer mode. Plant hundreds of seeds with the Seed Minigun. Explore long-awaited new areas and scale up your farming to accomplish your biggest challenge yet. Complete your mission!

The 1.0 release introduces new endgame content, mech upgrades, automation improvements, and quality-of-life enhancements, alongside even more ways for players to build, grow and enjoy their homestead experience, shaped by player feedback throughout Early Access.

Play now on Steam and Xbox
